scope: Proposition 12.4 of the manuscript “Cuntz comparison and Jiang–Su absorption” (preprints/Cuntz-comparison-and-Jiang-Su-absorption-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 291 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 5cbeda4528e0e671), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 54. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A be a separable nuclear C∗-algebra satisfying (C). For each p ≥ 2 there are a c.p.c. order-zero map α : Mp → Aω ∩ A′, with h = α(1), and an element S ∈ Aω ∩ A′ such that α(e11)S = S, S∗ Sa = (1 − h)a (a ∈ A). (12.6) One can choose ∥S∥ ≤ 2. In the second equation the expression (1−h)a is computed in the unitization of Aω and belongs to Aω.
